title: Pokemon Flygon ex 106/191 Surging Sparks Tera Rare NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokémon TCG — Flygon ex (Tera), #106/191, Surging Sparks (SV8).
Stage 2 (Evolves from Vibrava), HP 310. Tera Pokémon — while on your Bench, prevents all attack damage to this Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). Attacks: Reversing Storm (130 dmg, may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon), Sonic Peridot (100 dmg to each of opponent's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V, unaffected by Weakness/Resistance). Pokémon ex rule — opponent takes 2 Prize cards on KO. Illustrated by 5ban Graphics.
Ungraded, near mint or better — see photos for the actual card. Ships sleeved in a top-loader inside a rigid mailer.
